s: Seder massa umattan ubo k"a seipim: lo ameru (veken hu beperush rashi"y bithillim siman qit al pasuq "et laasot laHashem heperu torateka" ubeyyalqut sham) qebiat ittim lattora, ella bemi shetztzarik laasoq bederek eretz lehachayot napsho venapshot beto. Abal mi sheen tzarik lekak, o shemmitparnes mishshel acherim — chayyab leqayyem "vehagita bo yomam valayla" kemashmao (veayyen besanhedrin pereq cheleq dap tz"t a"b ubimnachot pereq y"a dap tz"t a"b tze ubedoq ku', ushear tannae sham lo pelige ella bemi shetztzarik laasoq bederek eretz, ubeabot derabbi natan pereq k"a ubemidrash rabba resh peticheta deeka ubeqohelet rabba py"b, d dap qt"v a al pasuq "bishpal qol hattachana" — mah tachana zo ku'). Veap mi shetztzarik lekak — lo yaaseh melakto iqqar ella aray kede parnasato bilbad vetorato qeba, vezeh vezeh yitqayyemu beyado. Abal kol tora sheen immah melaka — sopah betela, ki haoni yaabirennu al daat qono. Ella mi shechoshqa napsho battora venasa libbo leqayyem mitzva zo karauy — yaaseh melaka meat bekol yom kede chayyayv, ushear yomo velelo oseq battora:

Ukesheoseh melaka o nose venoten — lo tihyeh kavvanato ella kede limtzo tzorke haggup kede sheyyukal laabod leboreo, kemo shekkatub: "bekol derakeka daehu vego'" (mishle siman g', v') (veayyen mizzeh beabot derabbi natan py"z ubishmona peraqim leharamba"m pereq h). Vechayyab kol adam lelammed libno melaka o laasoq bischora. Veim eno oseh ken — keillu melammedo listut, shessopo lelastem et habberiyyot bishbil parnasato. Veyizzaher lissa velitten beemuna shello yachalip et dibburo, shenneemar: "vehin tzedeq yihyeh lakem", sheyyihyeh hen shelleka — tzedeq, velav shelleka — tzedeq, kelomar kesheatta medabber hen o lav — qayyem debareka vehatzdeq otam (veayyen beharamba"m pereq h' mehilkot deot halaka y"g upereq z' mehilkot mekira halaka ch' ubeperush hammishnayot sop shebiit ubishla"h bemasseket chullin shello dap qy"d a"a gabbe inyan massa umattan beemuna). Vekol hammachalip et dibburo — keillu obed kokabim umazzalot. Vaapillu machashaba shennigmera belibbo — tob leqayyemah kol mi sheyyesh beyado yirat shamayim, shenneemar: "vedober emet bilbabo" (tehillim siman tv). Bammeh debarim amurim? Bedabar shebbeno lachabero, abal (im) dibre atzmo mitztzerakayv im en bahen semak mitzva — en tzarik leqayyeman. Vaapillu mippene hashshalom lo yabtiach sheqer lachabero. Velo ameru "muttar leshannot mippene hashshalom", ella besippur debarim shekkebar aberu (umikkol maqom tzarik iyyun qetzat, kevan shehashshalom gadol mikkol hammitzvot kemo shekkatub bemidrash rabba parashat chuqqat al pasuq "baqqesh shalom veradepehu", ubaggemara hittir leshannot dibburo mippene hashshalom, vehari"p pereq ellu metziot katab delav hetter hu ella mitzva, im ken minnalan dilshannot bilhabba asur, shemma yesh lehattir, al derek "bekol derakeka daehu" p"t dibrakot dap s"g a"a, veayyen bemidrash rabba parashat bereshit pereq a', veayyen beeliyya rabba mizzeh ubipri megadim), velo bedabar shellehabba. Veyizzaher millehazkir shem shamayim lebattala, shebbekol maqom shehazkarat hashshem metzuya — mita o aniyyut metzuya (upashut lechalleq ben din zeh uben sheilat shelom chabero bashshem shehittiru chakamim bemishna pereq t' dibrakot). Veyizzaher millishshaba apillu baemet, sheelep ayarot hayu lo leyannay hammelek vekullam nechrebu, lepi shehayu nishbaim shebuot ap al pi shehayu meqayyemim otam:

Mitzvat aseh min hattora lelek bedarke Hashem, shenneemar: "vehalakta bidrakayv" (beparashat tabo kach, t). Vekak lamedu beperush mitzva zo: mah hu niqra "channun" — ap atta heyeh channun veoseh mattenat chinnam, mah hu niqra "rachum" — ap atta heyeh rachum, mah hu niqra "erek appayim" — ap atta heyeh erek appayim. Veken shear kol hammiddot sheyyesh baadam — tzarik lehadmot atzmo bahem leboreo, velimos bara shebbahem velibchor battob. Veketzad yargil adam atzmo bemiddot tobot ad sheyyiqqabeu bo? Yaaseh veyishneh vishallesh bammaasim sheoseh al pi hammiddot haellu, veyachazor bahem tamid ad shettihyeh asiyyatan qalla beenayv veyiqqabeu hammiddot benapsho, kegon im haya kilay — yepazzer veyitten mamon harbeh laaniyyim veyigmol chesed gam laashirim, veyachazor veyitten ad shettiqqaba benapsho middat "verab chesed" shennishtabbeach bah haqqadosh baruk hu. Veachar shettiqqaba benapsho midda zo (baarakin pereq hammaqdish sadehu dap k"ch a"a bammishna ugemara sham ubiktubbot pereq naara dap n' a"a, veayyen beperush rashi"y pereq b' debetza dap t"z a"a ubepereq v' dechullin dap p"d a"a) — lo yepazzer yoter midday, shezzo enah derek toba, vetaqqanat chakamim shello yebazbez yoter mechomesh, ella yinhag bederek hammitztzua hu derek hattoba vehayshara. Chutz mishshiplut haruach, she"meod meod heve shepal ruach", ki "toabat Hashem kol gebah leb" (mishle siman taz, Hashem), laken yitracheq mizzeh ad qatzeh haacharon. Vekol hammagbiah lebabo — keillu kapar baiqqar, shenneemar: "veram lebabeka veshakachta et Hashem vego'" (beparashat eqeb ch', y"d). Vekol mi sheyyesh beyado gassut haruach — hu kaashera, veen aparo ninar bitchiyyat hammetim. Veken hakkaas midda raa meod umiggassut haruach hi baa, laken yitracheq mizzeh gam ken ad qatzeh acharon. Vaapillu im tzarik likos al haam lehaprisham middebar abera ulehachaziram lammutab — yareh atzmo keillu hu koes, vetihyeh dato meyushshebet alayv beno leben atzmo. Veameru chakamim: kol hakkoes — keillu obed kokabim umazzalot, venishmato mistalleqet mimmennu, shenneemar: "torep napsho beappo" (beiyyob siman y"ch, d). Lepikak tzivvu lehitracheq min hakkaas, ad sheyyanhig atzmo shello yargish kelal ledibre hammakisim. Vezo derek tzaddiqim: alubim veenam olebim, shomeim cherpatam veenam meshibim, osim meahaba usemechim bayyissurim, vaalehem hakkatub omer: "veohabayv ketzet hashshemesh bigburato" (beseper shopetim sop siman h'). Veim hu talmid chakam vecherepo ubizzahu echad mehaam — hu lo yashib al cherpato, umikkol maqom yihyeh lo onesh al bizyon hattora. Veim yabo acher linqom niqmato beqiyyum hammishpat — yishtoq velo yimcheh beyado. Veal zeh ameru: kol talmid chakam sheeno noqem venoter kenachash — eno talmid chakam, hoil veen torato chashuba beenayv veeno maqpid al bizyonah. Umikkol maqom im mepayyesim oto — tzarik lehitpayyes miyyad, shebbepiyyus zeh kebar nitqan kebod hattora. Veal zeh ameru: kol hammaabir al middotayv umochel lemi shemmepayyeso — maabirin lo al kol peshaayv. Vekol zeh betzaar haggup, abal bedabar shebbemamon — ap talmid chakam asur littor belibbo, veen tzarik lomar linqom. Vehannoqem mechabero o hannoter — ober belo taaseh shenneemar: "lo tiqqom velo tittor et bene ammeka" (beparashat qedoshim tihyu). Ezehu neqima? Amar lo "hashileni qardummeka" velo hishilo, ulemachar ba chabero etzlo veamar lo "hashileni maggaleka", veamar lo "eni mashileka kederek shello hishaltani" — zo hi neqima. Veim amar lo "hareni mashileka veeni kemoteka" — zo hi netira. Ella yimcheh haddabar millibbo, velo yazkirennu, velo yaaleh al leb leolam. Vetzarik kol haadam lizzaher bezeh:

(Ramba"m beseper hammitzvot baasayin siman v', vegam haramba"n bahassagot sham siman z' modeh lezeh, vekol shekken sheha"megillat ester" sham sq"b katab sheen haggirsa kemo shekkatab haramba"n. Veken hu bepereq qamma ditmura dap g' sop a"b kidbarayv, veken peresh rashi"y sham. Sm"g asayin siman ch') mitzvat aseh liddabeq beyodee Hashem ubetorato, shenneemar: "ubo tidbaq" (beparashat eqeb yv"d, k'). Venikpal hatztzivvuy bemaqom acher, shenneemar: "uledobqa bo" (sop parashat nitztzabim). Veameru raza"l: veki epshar laadam liddabeq bashshekina? Ella kak ameru chakamim beperush mitzva zo: hiddabeq bachakamim ubetalmidehem kede lilmod maasehem. Veken tzivvu chakamim veameru: heve mitabbeq baapar raglehem veheve shoteh batztzama et dibrehem. Lepikak, tzarik kol adam lehishtaddel lissa bat talmid chakam, ulehassi bitto letalmid chakam, veleekol velishtot im talmide chakamim, velaasot peraqmatya letalmide chakamim, ulehitchabber lahem bekol mine chibbur, shenneemar: "uledobqa bo". Vekol hanneheneh misseuda shettalmid chakam sharuy betokah — keillu neheneh mizziv hashshekina. Veod dareshu besipre sham: "uledobqa bo" — lemad dibre aggada, shemmittok kak atta makkir et mi sheamar vehaya haolam (veayyen beabot derabbi natan pereq k"t. Veayyen baggemara pereq batra deyoma dap a"h a"a al pasuq "vehamman kizra gad hu", vehu mehammekiletta):

Mitzva al kol adam leehob et kol echad veechad kegupo, shenneemar: "veahabta lereaka kamoka". Lepikak tzarik lachus al kebodo veal mamono, kemo shechas al kabod umamon shello. Vehammitkabbed biqlon chabero — en lo cheleq laolam habba:

Kesheyyecheta ish leish lo yistemennu veyishtoq, ella mitzva alayv lehodio velomar "lamma asita li kak vekak", shenneemar: "hokeach tokiach et amiteka". Veim rotzeh limchol lo velo lehokicho — hare zeh middat chasidut, velo hiqpida hattora ella al hammastema:

Haroeh et chabero shechata o shehalak bederek lo toba — mitzva alayv lehachaziro lammutab, ulehodio shehu chote al napsho bemaasayv haraim, shenneemar: "hokeach tokiach et amiteka". Veim lo qibbel mimmennu — yachazor veyokichennu, shenneemar: "hokeach tokiach" — apillu mea peamim, ad sheyyakkennu hachote o yeqallelennu. Veeno mechuyyab lehokiach ella amito shehu chabero shehu gas bo, abal ish acher sheim yokichennu yisnaennu veyinqom mimmennu — eno tzarik lehokicho, kevan shebbevadday lo yishma lo. Abal chabero apillu im yodea shello yishma lo — chayyab lehokicho, ella im ken hu chote beshogeg, sheaz anu omerim: mutab sheyyihyeh shogeg veal yihyeh mezid. Verabbim apillu hem mezidin — en lehokicham yoter mippaam achat im yadua lo sheddebarayv enam nishmaim. Veal zeh ameru: keshem shemmitzva lomar dabar hannishma — kak mitzva shello lomar dabar shello nishma. Veim hem shogegim — en lehokicham kelal, shemmutab sheyyihyu shogegim veal yihyu mezidim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyachid hammokiach, abal al habbet din muttal lehokicham veligor bam, shello yihyu nitpasim beoto avon. Vaapillu hu dabar sheissuro eno ella missapeq, vaapillu im rabbim hem hashshogegim. Veen lahem lehishshamet velomar: mutab sheyyihyu shogegin veal yihyu mezidim, ella im ken hu issur sheeno meporash battora uparetzu bo rabbim mippene chesron emunatam baissur, sheaz qasheh meod limchot beyadam, shei epshar lebet din lehaamid shoterim bebet kol echad. Veal zeh ameru: hannach lahem leyisrael miqqetzop alehem umiggear bam, mutab sheyyihyu shogegin veal yihyu mezidim:

Kol hammokiach et chabero, ben bidbarim shebbeno lebeno ben bidbarim shebbeno leben hammaqom — tzarik lehokicho beno leben atzmo, vidabber lo benachat ubelashon rakka, veyodio sheeno omer lo ella letobato. Veim dibber itto qashot vehiklimo — ober belo taaseh, shenneemar: "velo tissa alayv chete". Kak ameru chakamim: yakol atta mokicho upanayv mishtannot — talmud lomar "velo tissa alayv chete" (veap al pi sherashi"y sham peresh dehaynu kesheyyokichenu barabbim lehalbin panayv, hinneh hasam"g veharamba"m pereshu shello yokichennav bidbarim qashim ad sheppanayv nishtannot vehaynu apillu beno lebeno). Mikkan sheasur leadam lehaklim et chabero apillu beno lebeno, veen tzarik lomar barabbim. Lepikak lo yiqraennu beshem shehu bosh mimmennu, velo mesapper lepanayv dabar shehu bosh mimmennu. Vekol hammalbin pene chabero barabbim — en lo cheleq laolam habba. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bidbarim shebben adam lachabero, abal bedibre shamayim im lo chazar bo — tzarik lehokicho barabbim ad sheyyachazor lammutab, kemo sheasu kol hannebiim beyisrael. Vekol zeh baabera shebbasseter, abal im abar abera begaluy — yokichennu miyyad, shello yitchallel shem shamayim. Vetalmid sheraa et rabbo ober abera — yomar lo "limmadtani rabbenu kak vekak", lehazkiro ulay shogeg hu. Veim eno shomea lo — lo yokichennu od, mah sheen ken bachabero kemo shennitbaer:

Chayyab adam lizzaher bitomim vealmanot apillu hem ashirim gedolim. Vekol hammaqnitan, o hikisan, o hikib libbam, o rada bahen, o ibbed mamonan — hare zeh ober belo taaseh, shenneemar: "kol almana veyatom lo teannun". Vekol shekken hammakkeh otan o hamqallelan. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bizman sheinna otan letzorek atzmo, abal im inna otan rabban kede lelammedan tora o ummanut o leholikan bederek yeshara — hare zeh muttar. Veap al pi ken lo yinhag bahen minhag kol adam, ella yaaseh lahem hepresh, vinahalem benachat uberachamim gedolim, echad yatom meab veechad yatom meem. Vead emat niqraim yetomim leinyan zeh? Ad shello yihyu tzerikin leadam lehissamek alayv uleomnan ulehittapel bahen, ella yihyeh oseh kol tzorke atzmo leatzmo kishar kol haggedolim:

Hamraggel bachabero — ober belo taaseh, shenneemar: "lo telek rakil beammeka" (qedoshim y"t, t"z). Ezehu rakil? Zeh shettoen debarim veholek mizzeh lazeh veomer: kak vekak amar peloni, kak vekak shamati al peloni, ap al pi shehu emet veenan debarim shel genay kelal, vegam oto peloni lo makchisham kelal — hare zeh macharib et haolam, shemmizzeh yukal labo lipamim lide shepikat damim, kemo sheameru bemaaseh doeg im achimelek (uleshon hakkesep mishneh kak hu, sherakil haynu: haomer peloni upeloni amar aleka kak vekak o asa leka kak vekak ku'. Vezeh leshon hasam"g sham: ezehu rakil? Hamgalleh lachabero debarim sheddibber mimmennu adam basseter, vehebi reaya mehammishna pereq g' desanhedrin vehaggemara sham dap l"a, a'. Veken mashma bearuk sop erek lashon, vezeh leshono: "lo telek rakil" — targum yerushalmi "lishena telitai". Veayyen pereq g' [daarakin] dap t"v a"b baggemara uperush rashi"y d"h lishena telitai, vehattosapot sham pereshu beinyan acher, ubeharaaba"d behilkot deot resh pereq z' mashma keperush rashi"y. Veken mashma bemidrash rabba resh parashat emor). Vehamqabbelo neenash yoter min haomero, ella im ken hu roeh debarim hannikkarim. Ubiklal lav zeh hu lashon hara, vehu hamsapper bignut chabero ap al pi sheamar emet. Vaapillu amar: hekan matzuy ur tadir im lo bebet peloni shemmatzuy etzlo basar vedagim — hare zeh lashon hara im hotzio bederek lashon hara, shennitkavven legnut shehu bezolele basar lamo. Abal haomer sheqer al chabero — niqra motzi shem ra. Veayyen pereq d' diktubbot dap m"v a"a:

Echad hamsapper belashon hara bipne chabero o shello bepanayv, vehamsapper debarim sheggoremim, im nishmeu ish mippi ish, lehazziq chabero begupo o bemamono, o letzaaro, o lehapchido, ap al pi sheenan debarim shel genay al chabero — hare zeh lashon hara. Veim neemru debarim ellu bipne shelosha — kebar nishma haddabar venoda. Veim sipper haddabar echad min hashshelosha paam acheret — en bo mishshum lashon hara. Vehu shello yitkavven lehaabir haqqol ulegalloto yoter. Veim haomer mazhir shello leomro, apillu amar bipne rabbim — yesh bo mishshum lashon hara. Bammeh debarim amurim keshemmesapper bipne chabero o bipne shelosha yesh bo mishshum lashon hara lehaomer, kesheomer dabar shel qintur ugenay, o dabar sheyyakol ligrom lo nezeq o tzaar. Abal dabar sheyyesh lomar sheen kavvanato lelashon hara, kegon hekan matzuy ur bebet peloni shemmatzuy lo basar — en bo mishshum lashon hara im omer ken bepanayv, veken im amar bipne shelosha, shehare zeh keomer bepanayv, shei epshar shello yaggia haddabar beoznayv:

Abaq lashon hara ketzad? Mi yomar liploni sheyyihyeh kemo shehu atta, o sheyyomar: shitqu mippeloni eni rotzeh lehodia ma era umeh haya, vekayyotze bidbarim haellu. Vekol hamsapper betobato shel chabero bipne soneayv, o bipne rabbim mehaam sheyyesh lachosh sheyyesh bahem echad missoneayv — hare zeh abaq lashon hara, shehu gorem shessoneo yesapper bignuto. Abal bipne ohabayv muttar lesapper bishbachayv, ubilbad shello yarbeh yoter midday, mittok shemmesapper umoneh middotayv i epshar shello yabo lide genut. Veken hamsapper lashon hara derek rammaut, vehu shemmesapper letummo keillu eno yodea sheddabar zeh sheddibber lashon hara hu o shezzeh asa peloni. Veayyen od mah shekkatab haggahot maymoniyyot sham sq"g bayyerushalmi muttar ku', vehu gam ken beyalqut cheleq b remez qs"v. Veayyen magen abraham beshem haggahat sm"q. Veayyen mah shekkatabti behilkot nizqe mamon seip z ubeshulchan aruk choshen mishpat siman tk"a sop seip y"g debikhay gavna dehatam mayyare bayyerushalmi:

Oreach eno rashshay leshabbeach et baal habbayit shehu tob ayin, shemma yirbu alayv orechim veyoklu kol asher lo. Veal zeh neemar: "mebarek reehu beqol gadol babboqer hashkem — qelala techasheb lo" (bemishle siman k"z, y"d). Veayyen od mippasuq zeh beabot derabbi natan sop pereq y"a:
Kol haomer dabar lachabero hu be"bal yomar", ad sheyyomar lo "lek emor":

Asur limnot et yisrael apillu eno mitkavven raq lehatil goral al ezeh sekum umispar, vaapillu lidbar mitzva, ella motziim etzbeotehem umonim haetzbaot. Ketib: "yabi bemishpat al kol nelam" besop qohelet, lerabbot apillu hahoreg kinna bipne chabero:

Hassach sichat chullin, vehu sichat hayyaldut veqallut rosh — ober baaseh, shenneemar: "vedibbarta bam", "bam" — velo bidbarim acherim. Veap im qaba ittim lattora — lo yaasoq bishar hayyom ella bidbarim sheyyesh bahem tzorek, abal lo besichat hayyaldut veqallut rosh, ella yachazor lelimmudo. Uqebiat haet enah ella lehachamir, shello yimshok kol hayyom bederek eretz kemo shennitbaer leel seip a':
Zerizim maqdimim lemitzvot, veen tzarik lehaqdim yoter meammud hashshachar:

Kol hammachanip bidbar abera mechamat yirato mippene baal abera veeno choshesh al yirat haqqadosh baruk hu — onsho gadol. Ak im mityare shello yahargennu — muttar lomar lo "yapeh asita" apillu abar abera gedola. Velo aseru lachanop ella shello bimqom sakkana. Veayyen beseper yereim siman n"h ubekad haqqemach ot ch' ubereshit chokma shaar haqqedushsha pereq y"b:

Al yaamod adam bimqom sakkana veyomar sheosin lo nes, shemma en osin lo nes. Veim osin lo nes — menakkin lo mizzekuyyotayv. Veyesh mehachakamim shehaya nimna laabor bispina sheyyesh bah reshaim gemurim, shemma nipqad din alehem veyittapes immahem. Veyesh mehachakamim shehaya machazir laabor bispina sheyyesh bah yehudim veenam yehudim, amar shehassatan eno sholet bishte ummot. Veayyen magen abraham sop siman zeh:

Kol mi shehiqqiz dam veen lo bemah lehabrot napsho — natenu lo chakamim etza sheyyittol beyado dinar ra veyelek etzel hachenvani veyitom yayin im tob hu liqnoto, veachar kak kesheyyirtzeh liqnot lo yiqqach hachenvani et haddinar, veyelek lo etzel chenvani acher veyaaseh ken ad sheyyitom rebiit. Veap al pi shebbahaqqaza shellanu en chashash kol kak, mikkol maqom yesh lilmod mizzeh lishar choli:
Bedibre tora — "aneh kesil keivvalto, pen yihyeh chakam beenayv". Abal bedibre haolam — "al taan kesil keivvalto, pen tishveh lo" (bemishle siman k"v):
